# §1/0 — 0/1 = / ≠ 1/0

## #0 — The completed figure faces its condition

T1 has made the sixfold available as a placed and directed figure. Its completion now turns toward the condition from which every placement was made. In native QL, `0` is the singular One, `1` the polyvalent All, and `/` their relating activity. The orientation `0/1` carries the One into manifestation; `1/0` carries manifestation toward recognition of its condition. The phase-flip operates their meeting.

The input is the completed figure together with its source relation. The result keeps the figure and changes how it is entered: from the achieved toward the given, from circumference toward centre. [The Two Ones](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) retain the two offices, while [the whole/many relation](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) holds their reciprocal dependency. The One depends on the All for manifestation; the All depends on the One for being and coherence. The turn makes this dependency recognisable within what has already become definite.

At the [Binary Explication's §1/0 hinge](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md), the placed T1 figure turns toward the T0 reading of its source relation. Its slash is active at the point where a placed description begins to read its own relation to what it describes.

## #1 — The copula retains identity and reversal

The source writes the hinge as

$$
0/1\ =\ /\ \ne\ 1/0.
$$

The spaced display preserves its source heading. It is a QL copular construction: the two orientations are held as the same structure and as different phases. The slash between equality and non-equality retains that joint reading. Its inputs remain distinct enough for the inverse to do work, while their identity lets that work return to the same field.

As ordered notation, inversion sends `(0,1)` to `(1,0)` and sends it back on a second application. It preserves the two terms and reverses their offices. As real-number arithmetic, `0/1=0` while `1/0` is undefined. The phase operation uses the ordered orientation, so the native copular relation does not assert equality of those evaluated fractions.

[Identification through difference](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) keeps what is identified answerable to the difference through which it is identified. [The formal limit](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) leaves this constitutive relation active: representing the condition produces another determination, with its own source relation still active. The inverse can expose that relation without completing a final inventory of its condition. The turn preserves the achieved expression while reopening what its expression depends on.

## #2 — Both parents contain the whole in reversed coordinates

The source gives each implicate parent a complete internal field. In the `0/1` parent, the four local contents are `0/1, 0/0, 1/1, 1/0`, bounded by `0` and `1`. In the `1/0` parent, their order is reversed, including the poles:

| Internal slot | `0/1` parent | Inverse-phase slot | `1/0` parent |
|---|---|---|---|
| #0 | `0` | #0′ | `1` |
| #1 | `0/1` | #1′ | `1/0` |
| #2 | `0/0` | #2′ | `1/1` |
| #3 | `1/1` | #3′ | `0/0` |
| #4 | `1/0` | #4′ | `0/1` |
| #5 | `1` | #5′ | `0` |

These are the parents' **internal** coordinates. They differ from the outer table, where `0/0`, `0/1`, `1/0`, `1/1` occupy #1 through #4. Stating the coordinate system matters: a local #1 can contain the expression whose outer address is #2.

The table admits an exact finite description. If the forward contents are an ordered six-tuple `F`, the inverse tuple has entry `F(5−j)` at local slot `j′`, for `j=0,…,5`. Reversing twice restores every entry because `5−(5−j)=j`. One reversal retains six contents while changing their order; a second restores the order. The two applications remain distinguishable in the recorded traversal even when its final tuple matches its initial tuple.

The source's Structure/Formality cross-reading compares local pairings with their outer content addresses. Local `#1/#4` contains expression/inverse, the outer `#2/#3` pair. Local `#2/#3` contains indeterminacy/unity, the outer `#1/#4` pair. The implicate pole-pair remains the axis of both readings, although its two entries exchange places. [The eight determinations](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) hold the complete field within which these nested addresses can be read. The phase-flip preserves that field's contents and makes their differing organisation explicit.

## #3 — Re-entry makes the phase consequential

The inverse is now an input for continued operation. A single reversal changes the phase; applying reversal again returns the arrangement. With `R` denoting the tuple reversal just defined, the sequence is

$$
F\ \xrightarrow{R}\ R(F)\ \xrightarrow{R}\ F
\ \xrightarrow{R}\ R(F)\ \longrightarrow\cdots.
$$

The current arrangement records which of the two phases is active relative to the chosen initial arrangement. It does not by itself record how many complete cycles have occurred. Retaining that history requires the sequence of passages, or an additional cycle record. This distinction gives the re-entry comparison an exact operational content: recurrence can carry phase, while accumulated history has to be retained somewhere in the process.

This hinge retains an achieved distinction while turning it toward its own condition, beside [Spencer-Brown's re-entry](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form.md), where a distinction enters its own indicated field. The native claim is that the completed `0/1`, operated through its inverse, becomes pulse. The native comparison does not establish the historical attribution: the claims of oscillation, memory and imaginary values in Spencer-Brown still require their primary passages. The explicit reversal above supplies the operation actually worked here.

[Kauffman's iterant construction](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/kauffman/kauffman-2014-iterants-fermions-dirac-arxiv/kauffman-2014-iterants-fermions-dirac-arxiv.md#kauffman-2014-iterants-fermions-dirac-arxiv-q001) alternates the two views `[a,b]` and `[b,a]` through a one-step temporal shift. Its housed passage gives an independent formal neighbour for retaining alternation and the view from which it is read. The retained distinction and its alternate view enter [mark, re-entry and complex orientation](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/27-s3-p2-mark-reentry-complex.md), where re-entry and complex orientation receive their distinct formal developments. Neither ordered reversal nor elapsed recurrence alone establishes a lived duration.

## #4 — The description recognises its describer

T1 reads the field through AND+OR: terms are counted, placed and traversed. T0 reads the same field through AND/OR: terms stand in relation under the slash. At an explicit pair, `01` can be read as a binary string with value one; `0/1` reads the two terms through their directed relation. The field supplies both readings, and the switch of operation changes what can become visible.

The parent makes the change especially clear. In the placed account, #0 marks the centre. In the proportional account, its content is `(0/1)/(1/0)`: the expression and its inverse already related. What looked like a point in the map carries the whole activity through which a map can be made. The same recovery occurs from the achieved parent in inverse phase.

The source names this turn from IS to AM, from third-person description to first-person recognition. The one tracing the figure recognises its own distinguishing activity in what the figure presents. The first-person position is not reached by assigning another property to the described object. [Performed definition](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) brings the defining activity into the account of what is defined through precisely this turn.

This is the native subject operation, carried into the processual reading. The first-person reading has an exact consequence: the description remains available while its claim to stand outside the relation it describes is withdrawn. [Trust and faith under formal limit](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) bears the dependency recognised here. The dependency was already active; recognition gives it a new office within the account.

## #5→0 — The inverse returns the power of relation

The phase-flip belongs to the full Process circuit:

$$
0/1=4+2=5\to0=1/0=4'+2'=5'\to0'=0/1.
$$

The first field unfolds; completion faces its source; the inverse field unfolds; its return restores the originating orientation. Each equality gathers an earned QL stage, and each arrow gives the passage its direction. The full circuit retains both a recoverable arrangement and the recognition enacted by passing through its inverse.

Here the prime glyph marks File Two's inverse-phase positions. File Three's Night-pass sequence also uses primes, with a different office. The full [Process circuit](README.md) carries the intermediate inversion explicitly; Definition and Quilt preserve the short `0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 0/1` statement. The two chains hold different depths of articulation without changing the source relation they articulate.

[Arbitration and usurpation of measure](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) makes a determination answerable where it has acquired authority: the criterion can return to the conditions it measures and become answerable to them. The formal inverse does not perform that institutional return by itself. It keeps the distinction available between an achieved account and the relating power through which the account can be revised.

[Zero's changing office](../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/24-s2-p5-zero-changes-role.md) receives the achieved figure turned toward its condition. [Matheme](../README.md) holds both orientations so the next act can read the same definite content from its other side. The accomplished figure remains definite, its source remains operative, and inversion has returned the power of relation without making the two phases indistinguishable.
